dos.text: Use badge-type instead of manually inserting a <moz-badge>, it lazily creates and removes the badge element for you.
Set accesskey normally even inside a panel that opens and closes often, it's stashed and restored automatically across the owning panel's open/close cycle (a real workaround for bug 1588156).

donts.text: Don't rely on badged alone to show a notification dot with real content, it's a pure CSS attribute-selector hook with no JS behavior at all, distinct from badge-type which actually creates the badge element.
Don't set submenu after the item has already connected, it's only read once in connectedCallback, not an observed attribute.
